items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: John Alexander, missed breakfast at the Roseland Ballroom... Mr. Chick Webb said, 'Why don't you stay here, son.' I said, 'Well, I'll stay for another week.' So I stayed.

ctx.x: We got to Joanne. The first baby, a boy, was lost in childbirth. Then there was Joanne and Jonathan, right?

My son was born January the 4th, 1937, and I had a gun in my pocket and I was going to back to Chicago and Gene Krupa, Benny Goodman, Vido Musso, John Alexander, missed breakfast at the Roseland Ballroom, said you can't leave John Hammond. I said, I'm going, my wife's going to have a baby. Mr. Chick Webb said, "Why don't you stay here, son." I said, "Well, I'll stay for another week." So I stayed.
